original: DocSEAM: Bidirectional Cross-Page Encoding for Multi-Page Document Understanding

title.zh: 同一张表格换个分页位置，模型为什么会读错？
title.en: Why moving a page break can change a document answer

intro.zh: 在视觉编码之后，让每页先与前后邻页交换信息，再交给语言模型。
intro.en: Pages exchange local context before their visual representations reach the language model.

zh: 逐页独立编码时，跨页表格和段落会被切成孤立的视觉表示。DocSEAM 把当前页与前后页组成三页窗口，用注意力和方向门控交换有用信息，最后只输出增强后的当前页词元，保持语言模型输入长度不变。
作者在相同内容的重新分页测试中，比较保留结构与切断表格、段落两种切法。在 LongDocURL 上，原模型的额外分页损失为 2.3 个百分点，DocSEAM 为 0.7 个百分点。
en: DocSEAM enriches each page using a three-page neighborhood after visual encoding. Center-anchored attention and directional gates exchange relevant context, then return only the center-page tokens without lengthening the language model’s input.
In a controlled LongDocURL re-pagination test, the difference between structure-preserving and structure-breaking cuts is 2.3 percentage points for the original baseline and 0.7 for DocSEAM.

limits.zh: 输入词元不增加仍有计算开销：20 页、9B 模型的一项测试增加约 8% 延迟。不同骨干收益不一致，部分 4B 任务分数反而下降。
limits.en: Fixed token count is not free computation: one twenty-page 9B test adds about 8% latency. Gains vary by backbone, with regressions on some 4B tasks.

original: Mixture-of-Loops Transformer

title.zh: 反复使用同一组模型层，各轮之间传什么？
title.en: What should a shared model pass between loops?

intro.zh: 把各轮计算的键值表示作为可复用记忆，拆开记忆构建与预测读出。
intro.en: Reusable key-value memory connects loops, while memory construction and prediction readout are separated.

zh: 循环 Transformer 反复运行共享权重的网络层。MoLT 不只传递上一轮的隐状态，还让后续计算读取之前轮次和深度产生的键值记忆；U 型版本将记忆构建与预测读出分开，省去不影响最终预测的解码计算。
在 700M 对照中，U-MoLT 用约 232.8B 训练词元达到普通模型 400B 词元时的验证损失，作者据此报告约 1.7 倍词元效率。
en: MoLT makes keys and values reusable across loops and depths of a shared-weight Transformer. Its U-shaped variant separates memory construction from prediction readout, omitting decoder traversals that do not affect final predictions.
In a 700M comparison, U-MoLT reaches the baseline’s 400B-token validation loss at about 232.8B tokens, reported as roughly 1.7× token efficiency.

limits.zh: 同样训练 400B 词元时，总耗时约为对照的 1.99 倍；词元效率不等于计算效率。完全匹配计算预算仍需专门实验，接近普通模型的延迟也只在约 113M 小模型上验证。
limits.en: At the same 400B tokens, runtime is about 1.99× baseline. Token efficiency is not compute efficiency; a dedicated equal-compute run remains needed. Latency parity was tested on roughly 113M models.

original: Look Back: Reinforcement Learning with Counterfactual World Models

title.zh: 动作真的选得好，还是这次运气好？
title.en: Learning to distinguish a good action from good luck

intro.zh: 近期补读：回看一次真实经历，在相同环境随机性下比较另一个动作。
intro.en: Recent reading: compare another action against an observed experience while preserving environmental randomness.

zh: 普通世界模型可能在想象新动作时，连随机出现的障碍物也一起改变。反事实世界模型以真实经历为参照，尝试只改变动作后果，保留这一次遭遇的环境随机性。
REINFORCE Look Back 用替代动作的回报作为训练基线，减少运气对学习信号的干扰。作者在合成任务与改造的 Chrome 小恐龙游戏中验证，并分析了降低方差所需的条件。
en: A counterfactual world model conditions on an observed trajectory to predict alternative actions under the same environmental randomness, rather than imagining an unrelated new trajectory.

REINFORCE Look Back uses counterfactual returns as policy-gradient baselines to reduce environmental luck in the learning signal. Experiments cover synthetic tasks and a modified Chrome Dino game, alongside conditions for variance reduction.

limits.zh: 精确反事实下的无偏性质不保证近似模型也无偏。额外 PPO 对照的平均碰撞率与精确模拟版 RLB 接近；不能据此声称普遍胜过常用强化学习方法。
limits.en: Unbiasedness under exact counterfactuals does not remove learned-model bias. A supplementary PPO baseline has similar mean collision rate to simulator-based RLB, so broad superiority is not established.

original: Qwen-Image-HD: Autoregressive Diffusion for High Definition Image Generation

title.zh: 分块生成高清图像，怎样照顾整张画面？
title.en: Generating high-resolution images a tile at a time

intro.zh: 用局部边缘与整图缩略图提供不同尺度的上下文，再按依赖关系并行生成。
intro.en: Local boundaries and a canvas thumbnail supply complementary context for tile generation.

zh: Qwen-Image-HD 每次生成约 1K 大小的图块，同时读取上方、左方邻块的边缘和已完成画面的缩略图。共享画布坐标把这些不同尺度的输入对齐，避免保存所有历史高清图块。
同一反对角线上的图块没有直接的上下依赖，可以并行生成。论文在相同四张 GPU 的 4K 测试中，将串行方案的平均延迟从 166 秒降至 139 秒。
en: Qwen-Image-HD generates 1K tiles using upper/left boundary detail and a fixed-size thumbnail of the completed canvas. Shared coordinates align the two scales without retaining all previous high-resolution tokens.

Wavefront scheduling generates tiles on an anti-diagonal concurrently. With the same four-GPU budget, reported mean 4K latency falls from 166 seconds for Serial to 139 seconds for optimized Wavefront.

limits.zh: 并行方案的 Q-Judger 总分从 59.44 降至 58.52。模型裁判分数不是人工偏好；计时不含加载和预热，跨块协调也仍有取舍。
limits.en: Q-Judger Overall falls from 59.44 to 58.52. This model-judged score is not human preference. Timing excludes loading and warmup; cross-tile coordination remains a tradeoff.

original: Steerable by Design: Conditional Pretraining for Robust Control of Language Models

title.zh: 让模型从预训练开始，学会使用独立控制通道。
title.en: Learning a separate control channel during pretraining

intro.zh: 把目标行为的语义特征单独编码，让控制不只依靠文字提示。
intro.en: Semantic features provide a learned control path separate from ordinary text tokens.

zh: Mancelle 在预训练时提取文本片段的语义特征，用独立编码器处理，再通过交叉注意力影响文本生成。模型从一开始就学习依赖这个通道，而不是训练完成后才额外加控制向量。
作者在 3B 模型及同数据训练的 400M 对照中，报告目标概念在多种提示攻击后保留得更好。测试同时检查概念相关性、指令遵循和流畅度，使用模型裁判评分。
en: Mancelle conditions pretraining on semantic features processed by a separate encoder and read through cross-attention. Control is learned early rather than added only after training.

The authors report more persistent concept steering under input-channel attacks in 3B experiments and a matched-data 400M study. Evaluation uses model judgments of concept relevance, instruction following, and fluency.

limits.zh: 概念控制不等于全面安全保证。部分通用能力低于基线；直接修改内部表示仍能削弱控制，语义特征标注也有额外成本。
limits.en: Concept steering is not a general safety guarantee. Some capability scores trail baselines; direct internal interventions weaken control, and feature annotation adds cost.

original: Antom 3-in-1 Transformer: A Payment Foundation Model

title.zh: 基础模型，也可以学习交易行为与关系。
title.en: A foundation model for payment behavior and relationships

intro.zh: 近期补读：把交易序列、表格字段和用户关系结合，学习可跨业务复用的风险表示。
intro.en: Recent reading: combining event sequences, tabular fields, and relationships for reusable risk representations.

zh: Antom 分别编码交易历史、当前支付属性和用户关系，再按任务融合。它先用历史前缀与未来活动摘要的匹配等自监督目标预训练，再用风险标签适配不同业务，并不以生成文字为目标。
作者报告，在相同 0.5% 干预预算的线上比较中，相对 XGB-Online，总体损失率降低 37.88%。少标签实验也展示了预训练表示的复用价值。
en: Antom separately encodes histories, tabular payment attributes, and entity relationships, then fuses them by task. Self-supervised pretraining includes matching history prefixes with summaries of subsequent behavior, followed by business-specific adaptation.
At a matched 0.5% intervention budget, the authors report 37.88% lower overall loss rate than XGB-Online in their platform experiment. Limited-label studies also examine representation reuse.

limits.zh: 平台数据、训练配置和架构细节未完整公开，难以独立复现；公司内部线上收益也不能直接外推至其他支付平台。
limits.en: Internal data and full training and architecture details are not public, limiting independent replication. Gains on this platform cannot be assumed elsewhere.

original: LLMs Memorize Their Own Hallucinations During Post-Training

title.zh: 模型，会把自己编造的错误学进去吗？
title.en: Can a model learn its own mistakes as facts?

intro.zh: 最终答案得到了奖励，推理途中出现的错误事实，也可能一起被强化。
intro.en: A reward for a correct final answer can also reinforce false claims along the way.

zh: 研究者对六个开放模型进行后训练，提取模型在推理过程中生成的错误陈述，并追踪后续检查点对这些陈述的记忆变化。只评估最终答案的奖励，并不区分推理过程中的事实质量。
作者报告：得到训练强化的错误，在选择题探针中被再次选中的比例平均增加 4.83 个百分点；没有得到训练信号的对照组增加 0.17 个百分点。即使模型当场撤回错误，也仍可能记住它。
en: The researchers post-trained six open models, extracted false claims from their reasoning traces, and tracked recall across later checkpoints. Outcome-based rewards do not separately assess factual accuracy within the reasoning trace.

The authors report a 4.83 percentage-point average increase in recall of reinforced false claims in multiple-choice probes, compared with 0.17 points for an unreinforced control. Claims that a model subsequently retracts can still be memorized.

limits.zh: 选择题探针的错误召回不能直接换算为自由回答中的幻觉率；事实提取和判错也部分依赖模型。
limits.en: Multiple-choice recall is not a free-form hallucination rate. Fact extraction and classification also partly depend on another model.

original: MemOnce: A Scalable Memory Architecture for Large Language Models

title.zh: 长期记忆，只存一份，需要时再展开。
title.en: Store memory once. Reconstruct it when needed.

intro.zh: 将历史压缩为可复用的内部表示，再按需还原各层需要的缓存。
intro.en: Compact reusable representations replace repeated layer-wise storage of the full history.

zh: MemOnce 保存少量最终层内部状态作为压缩记忆。新输入到来时，模型只检索一次相关记忆，再按需解码出各层注意力需要的 KV 缓存。它学习的是内部表示，并非简单的文字摘要。
作者在 Qwen3.5-4B、百万 token 上下文配置下，报告预填充延迟降低 6.9 倍、吞吐提高 3.5 倍。这些结果对应论文中的特定硬件和评测设置。
en: MemOnce retains a small subset of final-layer hidden states as compressed memory. It retrieves relevant representations once, then reconstructs layer-specific KV caches on demand. The memory is a learned internal representation.
For the adapted Qwen3.5-4B at one-million-token context, the authors report 6.9× lower prefill latency and 3.5× higher throughput under their evaluation configuration.

limits.zh: 从头训练只验证到 1B 规模；复杂交互式编码、多步工具任务仍待充分验证。活跃显存缓存的压缩比例也不等于全部存储开销的下降比例。
limits.en: From-scratch training was tested only up to 1B parameters. Complex interactive coding and tool-use settings need more validation. Active GPU cache savings are not equivalent to total storage savings.

original: Searching for distant planets with Astra

title.zh: 从星光的一次变暗，到值得追踪的线索。
title.en: From a dip in starlight to a testable lead.

intro.zh: 一个 AI 辅助筛查公开天文数据的实践案例，结果仍是候选信号。
intro.en: A case study in AI-assisted astronomical search, with candidate signals still awaiting confirmation.

zh: 行星从恒星前方经过时，可能造成周期性的微弱变暗。两位业余天文爱好者使用模型查阅已有方法、编写软件，并筛查 Kepler、TESS 等公开数据。
其中一条流程先搜索候选，再进行细查，并检出了部分已确认行星作为初步验证。SETI Institute 的研究者独立找到了两个相同信号，后续仍需观测。
en: A transiting planet can cause a faint periodic dip in a star’s brightness. Two amateur astronomers used models to review methods, build software, and search public Kepler and TESS data.

One pipeline separated candidate screening from detailed checks and recovered some known planets. A SETI Institute astronomer independently found two of the same signals; further observations are still needed.

limits.zh: 双星遮挡、仪器变化也可能造成变暗。本文是实践案例，未量化相对传统流程的发现增益，也没有确认新行星。
limits.en: Binary stars and instrument effects can mimic transits. This case study does not quantify discovery gains over conventional workflows or establish newly confirmed planets.

original: Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say

title.zh: 算出了计算量，为什么还估不准训练时间？
title.en: Why FLOPs alone cannot predict a training job.

intro.zh: 训练任务的完成时间，还包含评估、检查点和共享集群的开销。
intro.en: Evaluation, checkpoints, and shared infrastructure also shape wall-clock runtime.

zh: 团队分析 272 次 H200 集群上的监督微调任务，仅使用运行前已知配置，训练 CatBoost 预测获得 GPU 之后到任务结束的时间，不包含排队。
五折交叉验证中，CatBoost 的平均绝对误差为 1.71 小时，测试过的最佳 FLOP 基线为 12.41 小时。评估量、保存策略和模型规模都是重要特征。
en: The team studied 272 supervised fine-tuning runs on H200s, predicting time from GPU allocation to completion using pre-dispatch configuration. Queue time is excluded.

In five-fold cross-validation, CatBoost achieved a 1.71-hour mean absolute error versus 12.41 hours for the best tested FLOP baseline. Evaluation workload, checkpoint policy, and model size were important features.

limits.zh: 数据来自一个环境、同一种 GPU；没有证明跨集群迁移效果，也未展示上线调度节省的成本。
limits.en: Results come from one environment and GPU type. Cross-cluster transfer and real scheduling savings were not established.

original: On-Policy Morphing into Hybrid Attention Models

title.zh: 哪些注意力层，值得保留下来？
title.en: Which attention layers are worth keeping?

intro.zh: 改造预训练模型时，让层选择也看到模型适应新结构后的表现。
intro.en: Choose a hybrid architecture while accounting for how its weights adapt.

zh: 混合模型在部分层保留完整注意力，其他层使用更省资源的线性注意力。FlashMorph2 在选择阶段就采样实际的离散结构，让模型使用自己产生的内部状态运行，并同时调整权重。
作者报告，相比 FlashMorph，RULER 平均提高 2.42 分、LongBench 提高 1.08 分。核心是减少选择阶段与实际模型运行方式的差异。
en: Hybrid models retain full attention in selected layers and use linear attention elsewhere. FlashMorph2 samples discrete architectures during selection, runs on self-generated hidden states, and adapts weights jointly.
The authors report average gains over FlashMorph of 2.42 points on RULER and 1.08 on LongBench, reducing mismatch between architecture selection and the adapted model.

limits.zh: 主要质量实验集中在 0.6B 和 1.7B 的 Qwen3 模型；超大规模模型收益尚需验证。
limits.en: Main quality experiments focus on Qwen3 at 0.6B and 1.7B. Benefits at much larger scales remain to be validated.

original: Strengthening our safeguards with frontier automated red-teaming

title.zh: 让安全测试，持续发现新漏洞。
title.en: Safety testing that adapts as defenses change.

intro.zh: 固定题库检查已知漏洞，适应性测试进一步探索新的失败路径。
intro.en: Static evaluations track known failures; adaptive evaluations search for new ones.

zh: Anvil 使用模型反复测试防护系统、记录尝试，再根据反馈调整后续测试。作者报告，在多个指定内部任务上，它比受雇的人类测试者更快发现严重漏洞。
这份研究区分静态和适应性评估，也观察了内部测试结果与实际攻击流量中的防护表现。
en: Anvil iteratively tests safeguards, records attempts, and adapts to feedback. Anthropic reports faster discovery of serious vulnerabilities than contracted human testers on specified internal tasks.
The study distinguishes static and adaptive evaluation and compares internal robustness measurements with observed attack traffic.

limits.zh: 系统使用强模型和外部测试者没有的内部反馈；实际流量改善也伴随其他防护升级，无法全部归因于 Anvil。
limits.en: The system uses strong models and privileged feedback unavailable to external testers. Other safeguard changes occurred alongside improvements in live traffic.

path.zh: How it works · Harnessing frontier capabilities…
path.en: How it works · Harnessing frontier capabilities…

original: WeMM-Video: Pushing the Frontiers of Open-Source Omni-Modal Video Understanding

title.zh: 把视频里的看见和听见对齐。
title.en: Aligning what a video shows with what it sounds like.

intro.zh: 时间戳、音视频交错排列，以及专门抑制重复输出的后训练。
intro.en: Timestamps, interleaved audio-visual tokens, and post-training against repetition.

zh: WeMM-Video 将音频压缩为每秒 10 个 token，与画面 token 按时间交错，再加上时间戳，帮助关联视觉和声音事件。
团队还收集重复、无休止输出的失败样本，用偏好优化抑制重复，再针对较难的音视频能力进行强化学习。
en: WeMM-Video compresses audio into ten tokens per second, interleaves them chronologically with visual tokens, and adds timestamps to align events.
The team mines repetitive and endless outputs for preference optimization, followed by specialist reinforcement learning for harder audio-visual tasks.

limits.zh: 作者报告广泛评测和业务应用，但业务收益缺少独立对照；榜单结论仍需按具体任务理解。
limits.en: The authors report broad evaluations and deployment, but independent business-impact comparisons are not provided.

original: Posterior Matching Distillation

title.zh: 生成更快，也要保留更多可能。
title.en: Fewer generation steps, more possible outcomes.

intro.zh: 同一个噪声输入可能对应多张合理图像，蒸馏需要保留这种多样性。
intro.en: One noisy input can correspond to many valid images. Distillation should preserve that diversity.

zh: PMD 给学生额外随机输入，让它从同一噪声状态产生不同结果，再用多种加权平均约束学习教师的条件分布。
作者证明了理想条件下的分布识别性质，并在 SDXL 和 FLUX.2 上报告四步生成的质量与多样性收益。
en: PMD adds stochastic input to the student and matches families of reweighted means, supervising the teacher’s conditional distribution of clean images.
The authors establish an idealized identification result and report quality and diversity benefits for four-step generation on SDXL and FLUX.2.

limits.zh: 理论保证不代表实际训练已恢复完整分布；训练仍需多次学生采样和额外对抗损失。
limits.en: The theoretical result does not establish full distribution recovery in practice. Training requires multiple student draws and an auxiliary adversarial loss.

original: Mind2Act World: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Embodied Mind, Physical Action, and Mind-Action Composition in Robotic Manipulation

title.zh: 机器人会判断、会动作，能把两者接起来吗？
title.en: Can robots compose reasoning and action?

intro.zh: 分别测试历史推理、精确动作，以及通过环境反馈衔接两者。
intro.en: A diagnostic view of memory-based decisions, physical execution, and their composition.

zh: 评测包含 30 个模拟操作任务、180 种配置。三组任务分别关注历史信息判断、精确执行和多阶段闭环操作。
受测最强 Agent 在前两组的成功率为 52.7% 和 39.0%，组合任务为 12.0%。研究进一步记录失败发生在哪个阶段。
en: The benchmark includes 30 simulated tasks and 180 configurations, separating history-based reasoning, precise execution, and multi-stage closed-loop manipulation.
The strongest evaluated agent succeeds on 52.7% of Mind and 39.0% of Act episodes, but only 12.0% of composed episodes. Diagnostics track where failures begin.

limits.zh: 组合任务更长、更复杂，低分不能全部归因于衔接失败；推理期间仿真暂停，结果不等于实时机器人能力。
limits.en: Composed tasks are longer and different, limiting causal attribution. Simulation pauses during inference, so these results do not establish real-time performance.

original: Welcome Inkling 2 Mini, Cutting-edge Performance for your Local Setup

title.zh: 同一组模型层，可以反复使用。
title.en: Reusing the same layers for deeper computation.

intro.zh: 权重共享让模型容量与计算深度可以分别设计。
intro.en: Weight sharing separates stored model capacity from computational depth.

zh: Inkling 2 Mini 的 24 层中，中间 12 层重复运行三次，共进行 48 次层计算。各轮共享权重，通过消息与门控传递信息。
还有可调整循环次数的研究版本，用来探索推理计算与质量之间的取舍。
en: Inkling 2 Mini repeats its middle twelve layers three times, giving 48 layer applications from 24 physical layers. Passes share weights and exchange gated messages.
A variable-loop research checkpoint explores the tradeoff between inference computation and output quality.

limits.zh: 重复计算仍需要时间，各轮也保留自己的缓存；可变循环版本尚未充分评估。
limits.en: Repeated computation still costs time and maintains pass-specific caches. The variable-loop checkpoint has not been deeply evaluated.

path.zh: What is new with Inkling 2 Mini?
path.en: What is new with Inkling 2 Mini?

original: Introducing harness adapters: adapt your favorite model to your harness to improve performance and cost

title.zh: 让模型在实际工具环境里接受训练。
title.en: Training inside the agent’s actual harness.

intro.zh: 冻结模型主体，在实际执行环境中训练小型强化学习适配器。
intro.en: Small RL-trained adapters learn within the real execution environment.

zh: 团队在 Pi、OpenCode、Hermes 三种工具环境中，分别为 Qwen3.8-27B 训练 LoRA。训练直接使用实际环境产生的行为轨迹。
在 Pi 环境的 SWE-bench Pro 最难 51 题上，作者报告成功率从 39.2% 提高到 64.7%，共同完成的任务也减少了工具调用。
en: The team trained Qwen3.8-27B LoRA adapters inside Pi, OpenCode, and Hermes, learning from trajectories produced by the real harnesses.
On the hard 51-task SWE-bench Pro subset under Pi, the authors report a success-rate increase from 39.2% to 64.7%, with fewer calls on jointly solved tasks.

limits.zh: 收益未清晰迁移到商业自动化任务；关闭思考模式后仍出现类似推理的普通输出，机制有待研究。
limits.en: Gains did not clearly transfer to business automation. Reasoning-like text also emerged in non-thinking outputs, leaving the mechanism open.

original: AlphaGenome 2: Deciphering how cells read DNA to better understand disease

title.zh: 同一段 DNA，在不同细胞中如何表达？
title.en: How the same DNA behaves in different cells.

intro.zh: 以细胞类型和状态为条件，预测特定环境中的变异作用。
intro.en: Conditioning on cell type and state to predict variant effects.

zh: AlphaGenome 2 把细胞类型或状态与 DNA 一起作为输入，并能将新实验中的基因活动压缩成状态表示，预测未测量的属性。
作者报告，在特定免疫细胞数据集上，因果变异识别比例从 16% 提高到 30%。研究关注被组织平均值掩盖的细胞特异效应。
en: AlphaGenome 2 conditions on both DNA and cell state. It can encode gene activity from new single-cell experiments and predict unmeasured properties.
On a specific immune-cell dataset, the authors report variant identification rising from 16% to 30%, targeting effects that tissue-level averages can obscure.

limits.zh: 这些是研究评测结果；模型尚未获得临床诊断验证。
limits.en: These are research results; the model has not been clinically validated for diagnosis.

path.zh: Redesigning AlphaGenome… · Analyzing new cell types…

original: TuringSpace: Grounding Spatial Intelligence in Action with Interactive CAPTCHAs

title.zh: 模型看错了，多想一会儿能纠正吗？
title.en: Can more reasoning repair a visual mistake?

intro.zh: 交互式空间任务检查观察、行动和纠正的完整过程。
intro.en: Interactive spatial tasks test the whole observe–act–correct loop.

zh: TuringSpace 提供 125 类合成空间任务，要求模型点击、拖动并观察结果。作者报告人类成功率为 94.1%，受测最强模型为 74.1%。
最强三个模型的失败案例中，57.1% 被归因为感知错误。其他模型的分析还发现，长推理有时会编造画面细节来维护早先的错误判断。
en: TuringSpace contains 125 synthetic spatial task types requiring clicks, drags, and observation of results. Reported human success is 94.1%, versus 74.1% for the strongest tested model.
Perception accounts for 57.1% of analyzed failures in the top three models. Separate trace analysis finds that extended reasoning can defend early mistaken beliefs.

limits.zh: 任务是合成网页，失败分析部分依赖模型标注；真实物理操作仍需独立验证。
limits.en: Tasks are synthetic web environments, and failure labels partly use model judgments. Real physical manipulation requires separate validation.

original: Do Frontier Model Ingredients Add Up? A Replicated Factorial Study of Small Language Models

title.zh: 模型的技术配方，收益能相加吗？
title.en: Do model improvements add up?

intro.zh: 同时测试组件组合，并用重复训练检查结果是否稳定。
intro.en: Test components together and repeat runs before choosing a recipe.

zh: 研究在约 5150 万活跃参数的模型上测试五项技术改动，选择 16 种组合，每种用两个随机种子重复训练。
专家混合、Muon 和 Gated DeltaNet 混合结构带来的损失下降最大。多数收益可以叠加，但组件间存在相互影响，单独有效的组件在组合中可能收益很小。
en: The study tests five changes on a model with roughly 51.5M active parameters, using sixteen selected combinations and two random seeds each.
MoE, Muon, and a Gated DeltaNet hybrid give the largest loss reductions. Gains mostly combine, but interactions mean a useful standalone component may add little in a recipe.

limits.zh: 规模和预算较小，专家模型拥有更多总参数；不能直接当作大模型架构排名。
limits.en: The setting is small and expert models have more total capacity. The results do not establish a universal large-model ranking.

original: Atto: Rethinking Compact Embedding Models

title.zh: 检索模型很小，整个系统也会更小吗？
title.en: A smaller embedding model, a larger index?

intro.zh: 缩小词表和模型，也要看输出向量与索引的成本。
intro.en: Model weights, output vectors, and index cost need separate accounting.

zh: Atto 通过缩小词表、精简上下文处理，再输出较宽的向量，探索极小检索模型的能力。
作者在三个 BEIR 数据集上报告：90K 参数版本的平均 nDCG@10 为 0.4257，23M 参数 MiniLM 为 0.4802。这个指标衡量排序质量，并非准确率。
en: Atto combines a smaller vocabulary and compact contextual processing with wider output embeddings to explore very small retrieval models.
On three BEIR datasets, the author reports mean nDCG@10 of 0.4257 for a 90K-parameter variant versus 0.4802 for 23M-parameter MiniLM. This is ranking quality, not accuracy.

limits.zh: 90K 版本输出 2048 维向量，高于 MiniLM 的 384 维；更小权重不代表更小索引。跨语言和更多领域仍需验证。
limits.en: The 90K variant outputs 2048 dimensions versus MiniLM’s 384. Smaller weights need not mean a smaller index; broader domain and language tests remain open.

original: FastFrames: Video Generation at Interactive Latency

title.zh: 视频生成的速度，怎样才能变成交互体验？
title.en: FastFrames: Video Generation at Interactive Latency

intro.zh: 每秒生成 30 帧，仍可能需要先等一秒才看到整段画面。
intro.en: FastFrames replaces pixel decoding and history-cache updates with lightweight networks, targeting the delay between an input and the first responsive frame.

zh: 每秒生成 30 帧，仍可能需要先等一秒才看到整段画面。FastFrames 关注用户输入之后，多久能看到反映这次输入的新画面。研究者发现，像素解码和历史信息缓存更新占了大量时间，于是分别训练轻量网络替代这两个步骤。作者报告，13 亿参数版本在单张 B200 上，480p 稳态响应延迟为 36 毫秒，VBench 质量接近延迟为 272 毫秒的对照模型。这提供了一种理解生成模型性能的角度——整个输出链路中的等待都影响体验。升到 720p 后，同一版本延迟增至 127 毫秒，解码器也需要针对每个模型微调。
en: FastFrames replaces pixel decoding and history-cache updates with lightweight networks, targeting the delay between an input and the first responsive frame. The authors report 36 ms steady-state response latency at 480p on one B200 for a 1.3B model, compared with 272 ms for their baseline at similar VBench quality.

limits.zh: 720p 延迟升至 127 毫秒；解码器需要针对具体模型微调。
limits.en: Latency rises to 127 ms at 720p, and the decoder requires model-specific fine-tuning.

original: Rumble-2-Flash: an open 0.5B speech model for 40+ languages

title.zh: 五亿参数的语音模型，怎样向大模型学习？
title.en: Rumble-2-Flash: an open 0.5B speech model for 40+ languages

intro.zh: Rumble-2-Flash 让小模型先自己转录音频，再由大模型沿着这份输出提供逐词概率反馈。
intro.en: Rumble-2-Flash is a 0.5B speech model trained on its own transcription trajectories with token-level feedback from a larger teacher.

zh: Rumble-2-Flash 让小模型先自己转录音频，再由大模型沿着这份输出提供逐词概率反馈。一个技术难点是，两个模型切分文字的方式不同。团队使用 GOLD 对齐对应的文本片段，让不同词表的模型也能传递训练信号。在 302 小时、涵盖 14 种英语口音的客服通话测试上，作者报告词错率为 7.86%，接近其对照的 300 亿参数模型的 7.78%。文章还展示了九种语言上的平均成绩，但尚不能据此判断全部 40 多种支持语言的效果。
en: Rumble-2-Flash is a 0.5B speech model trained on its own transcription trajectories with token-level feedback from a larger teacher. GOLD aligns text spans across different vocabularies. The authors report 7.86% word error rate on 302 hours of customer calls spanning fourteen English accents, close to the 30B comparison model’s 7.78%.

limits.zh: 九种语言的平均评测不足以代表全部四十多种支持语言。
limits.en: The reported nine-language average does not establish performance across all forty-plus supported languages.

original: DaisyRose-27B: Pushing the Frontier of Post-Training Efficiency

title.zh: 只有 1,200 个任务，能教会 Agent 什么？
title.en: DaisyRose-27B: Pushing the Frontier of Post-Training Efficiency

intro.zh: DaisyRose-27B 从 Qwen3.8-27B 出发，把训练任务设计在原模型容易犯错的地方。
intro.en: DaisyRose-27B uses 1,200 multi-step tasks selected around the base model’s weaknesses, with task inspection to remove reward loopholes.

zh: DaisyRose-27B 从 Qwen3.8-27B 出发，把训练任务设计在原模型容易犯错的地方。每个任务需要多步操作，团队检查模型的尝试，修复能靠漏洞拿分的题目。训练采用异步系统，128 张 H200 负责执行任务、收集经验，另 16 张负责更新模型，长任务运行期间学习持续进行。作者报告，Terminal-Bench 4.1 的单次尝试成功率从 5.6% 升到 12.0%。它展示了任务设计、执行环境和训练系统怎样共同影响学习。公布的表格逐项选取 BF16、FP8 两次运行中较高的成绩，也缺少多次独立训练的误差范围。
en: DaisyRose-27B uses 1,200 multi-step tasks selected around the base model’s weaknesses, with task inspection to remove reward loopholes. An asynchronous system separates experience collection on 128 H200s from learning on sixteen. The authors report Terminal-Bench 4.1 single-attempt success increasing from 5.6% to 12.0%.

limits.zh: 表格逐项取两种精度运行的较高值，且缺少独立训练的误差范围。
limits.en: Tables select the better BF16 or FP8 result per benchmark and do not report uncertainty across independent training runs.

original: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Heat Pump and Underfloor Heating Control: An End-to-End Case Study

title.zh: 在模拟器里学会供暖，搬进真实住宅会怎样？
title.en: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Heat Pump and Underfloor Heating Control: An End-to-End Case Study

intro.zh: 地暖的温度变化很慢，控制器调完阀门，房间要过一段时间才会有反应。
intro.en: Researchers trained a reinforcement-learning controller in EnergyPlus to adjust heat-pump supply temperature and thirteen underfloor-heating zones, then deployed it in an occupied Madrid home.

zh: 地暖的温度变化很慢，控制器调完阀门，房间要过一段时间才会有反应。研究者用 EnergyPlus 模拟一栋马德里住宅，让强化学习控制器练习同时调节热泵供水温度和 13 个区域的地暖阀门，再直接部署到有人居住的房子里。约两周的试验中，供水温度集中在 34°C 左右。现场还出现了模拟难以复现的情况：向阳房间关掉阀门后，室温仍会因日照上升。试验避开了最冷月份，也缺少同条件的传统控制器对照，因此实际能省多少电仍待测量。
en: Researchers trained a reinforcement-learning controller in EnergyPlus to adjust heat-pump supply temperature and thirteen underfloor-heating zones, then deployed it in an occupied Madrid home. During approximately two weeks, supply temperature clustered near 34°C. Sunlight still warmed some rooms after their valves were closed, illustrating the simulation-to-reality gap.

limits.zh: 试验避开最冷月份，缺少同条件传统控制器对照，尚不能量化节电收益。
limits.en: The trial avoided the coldest months and lacked a matched conventional-controller baseline, so energy savings remain unquantified.

original: GauntletScore: Auditable Fact-Checking That Matches the Best Published Checkers on LLM-AggreFact

title.zh: 核查 AI 生成的句子，怎样留下可复查的证据？
title.en: GauntletScore: Auditable Fact-Checking That Matches the Best Published Checkers on LLM-AggreFact

intro.zh: GauntletScore 把一句声明拆成多个可核查的问题，交由不同模型判断，保存每项判断的来源和置信程度。
intro.en: GauntletScore decomposes a claim into checkable questions, uses multiple model judgments, and retains evidence and confidence for review.

zh: GauntletScore 把一句声明拆成多个可核查的问题，交由不同模型判断，保存每项判断的来源和置信程度。系统只有在两个模型都发现矛盾时才把它计入反证。作者在 29,320 条声明上测得 79.51% 的平衡准确率，与当时榜首的 79.45% 接近。这个设计最值得看的地方是，复核者能追溯某项判断从哪来。代价是约八成声明仍要调用第三个模型。实验只检查给定原文是否支持声明，所用模型的身份和提示词也未公开。
en: GauntletScore decomposes a claim into checkable questions, uses multiple model judgments, and retains evidence and confidence for review. A contradiction counts as counterevidence only when two models agree. The authors report 79.51% balanced accuracy on 29,320 claims, close to the cited leader’s 79.45%.

limits.zh: 约八成声明仍需第三个模型；只测原文支持度，模型身份和提示词未公开。
limits.en: About eighty percent of claims still require a third model. Evaluation measures support from a supplied text; model identities and prompts were not disclosed.

original: TeleChat to Xing4: Advancing Frontier Agentic Models on Domestic Chips and Frameworks

title.zh: 大模型训练时，怎样让芯片少等彼此？
title.en: TeleChat to Xing4: Advancing Frontier Agentic Models on Domestic Chips and Frameworks

intro.zh: Xing 4 报告展示了硬件互联怎样影响训练方案。
intro.en: Xing4’s report explains how hardware topology shapes distributed training: frequent weight exchange stays within fast-connected Ascend groups, while aggregated gradients cross groups and communication overlaps backward computation.

zh: Xing 4 报告展示了硬件互联怎样影响训练方案。团队在高速互联的昇腾设备组内分摊模型权重，把更频繁的权重交换留在组内，跨组只同步合并后的梯度，同时让通信和反向计算尽量重叠。在 1,024 张加速卡的对照测试中，2850 亿参数模型的单步训练时间从 36.4 秒降到 31.8 秒。报告另记载了用 8,192 张昇腾 910C 卡做的预训练。前面的加速数字来自较小的测试集群，实际收益取决于网络拓扑和训练配置。
en: Xing4’s report explains how hardware topology shapes distributed training: frequent weight exchange stays within fast-connected Ascend groups, while aggregated gradients cross groups and communication overlaps backward computation. For a 285B model on 1,024 accelerators, the authors report step time falling from 36.4 to 31.8 seconds. Pretraining on 8,192 Ascend 910Cs is reported separately.

limits.zh: 加速数字来自较小测试集群，不能直接外推至完整预训练集群。
limits.en: The speed comparison comes from a smaller test cluster and cannot be directly extrapolated to the full pretraining system.

original: Learning from Distribution: Rethinking One-Hot Supervision for ASR and QA in Speech Language Models

title.zh: 为什么练会了转录，反而不擅长回答问题？
title.en: Learning from Distribution: Rethinking One-Hot Supervision for ASR and QA in Speech Language Models

intro.zh: 同一段语音，“请转录”和“请回答”要求不同。
intro.en: Training speech models only against transcription text can teach them to repeat audio instead of responding to a spoken question.

zh: 同一段语音，“请转录”和“请回答”要求不同。作者发现，只用标准转录文本作为训练目标，语音模型容易学成听到什么就复述什么。他们让一个冻结的文本模型提供每一步的候选词概率，再让听音频的模型去拟合这组概率。为节省存储，训练只保留最可能的几个词，以及其余词的概率总和。在仅使用转录训练样本的对照中，英语口语问答准确率从 2.44% 升到 40.20%，转录词错率也略有下降。这个差距属于特定训练设置，实验只覆盖 Whisper-large-v3 搭配 Qwen3-4B 的架构。
en: Training speech models only against transcription text can teach them to repeat audio instead of responding to a spoken question. This method uses a frozen text teacher’s next-token distribution rather than one-hot targets, storing only top candidates and residual probability mass. In a transcript-only comparison, spoken-English QA accuracy rises from 2.44% to 40.20%, while transcription error also slightly improves.

limits.zh: 实验集中在 Whisper-large-v3 与 Qwen3-4B 的特定组合。
limits.en: The experiment covers a specific Whisper-large-v3 and Qwen3-4B architecture; the size of the gain is setting-specific.

original: K2-Horizon: A Frontier Fleet of Open Source Language Models

title.zh: 混合专家也能用在注意力里吗？
title.en: K2-Horizon: A Frontier Fleet of Open Source Language Models

intro.zh: 常见的混合专家模型在前馈层为每个 token 选少量专家。
intro.en: K2-Horizon’s 36B model extends mixture-of-experts routing to attention value vectors.

zh: 常见的混合专家模型在前馈层为每个 token 选少量专家。K2-Horizon 的 36B 版本把这个做法也用在注意力的值向量上，也就是其他位置能从该 token 读到的内容。它从 64 个值专家中选 4 个，只缓存合并后的向量，因此这项改动不增加 KV 缓存的大小。用相同数据训练时，作者报告该模型每个 token 激活约 46 亿参数，在四项基准上比 320 亿参数的稠密版低 1.2–3.7 分。激活参数数衡量每步参与计算的权重，实际推理速度还受专家路由和硬件影响。
en: K2-Horizon’s 36B model extends mixture-of-experts routing to attention value vectors. It selects four of sixty-four value experts and caches their combined vector, avoiding a larger KV cache for this change. With matched training data, the authors report approximately 4.6B active parameters per token and scores 1.2–3.7 points below a dense 32B model on four benchmarks.

limits.zh: 活跃参数数不等于实际速度；模型九月已发布，十一月日期对应技术报告。
limits.en: Active parameter count does not determine wall-clock speed. The model was released in September; the November date refers to the technical report.

source: City University of Hong Kong · CyberOrigin
original: WinDEX: Metric 3D Hand Motion Reconstruction in the Wild for Dexterous Teleoperation and Policy Learning

title.zh: 怎样把第一人称视频变成机器人能学的动作？
title.en: WinDEX: Metric 3D Hand Motion Reconstruction in the Wild for Dexterous Teleoperation and Policy Learning

intro.zh: 头戴相机跟着人一起动，画面里的手部位移混合了手和头的运动。
intro.en: WinDEX separates hand motion from head-camera motion in first-person recordings.

zh: 头戴相机跟着人一起动，画面里的手部位移混合了手和头的运动。WinDEX 用双目相机估计手指和腕部的三维位置，再结合惯性传感器估计相机运动，把手部轨迹还原到固定坐标系。作者在相同训练设置下替换动作参考，五种物体、两种机械手的模拟抓取成功率平均为 61%，两个对照方案分别为 8% 和 17%。真机试验借助了外部相机定位，长时间遮挡和换用不同采集设备也仍是难点。
en: WinDEX separates hand motion from head-camera motion in first-person recordings. Stereo vision estimates wrist and finger positions, while inertial measurements recover camera movement and a fixed coordinate frame. Replacing action references under matched training yields 61% average simulated grasp success over five objects and two robot hands, versus 8% and 17% for two baselines.

limits.zh: 真机实验使用外部相机定位，长时间遮挡和跨设备迁移仍有困难。
limits.en: Real-robot trials used external-camera localization. Long occlusions and changes in capture hardware remain difficult.

source: Zhejiang University · Shanghai AI Laboratory · Shanghai Innovation Institute
original: JVT: Just Video Transformer makes pixel-space video diffusion simple

title.zh: 视频生成可以直接在像素上做吗？
title.en: JVT: Just Video Transformer makes pixel-space video diffusion simple

intro.zh: 许多视频扩散模型先用预训练的自编码器压缩视频，再在压缩后的表示上去噪。
intro.en: JVT generates video directly in pixel space rather than relying on a separate pretrained autoencoder.

zh: 许多视频扩散模型先用预训练的自编码器压缩视频，再在压缩后的表示上去噪。JVT 把原始视频划成跨帧的小块，先提取每帧的空间特征，再聚合同一位置随时间的变化，由 Transformer 直接预测去噪后的像素。这种设计让画面和逐像素的远近信息可以一起生成。在 RealEstate10K 上，加入远近信息后，严格阈值下的相对平移准确率从 72.4% 升到 79.5%，视频质量指标略有退步。论文的主要生成基准使用 16 帧短片，长视频的一致性仍需验证。先看 图 2、§3.2 和表 5。
en: JVT generates video directly in pixel space rather than relying on a separate pretrained autoencoder. It extracts spatial features within frames, aggregates changes across time, and predicts denoised pixels. Jointly generating depth raises strict relative-translation accuracy on RealEstate10K from 72.4% to 79.5%, with a slight loss in video-quality metrics.

limits.zh: 主要生成基准为十六帧短片，长视频一致性仍待验证。
limits.en: The main generation benchmarks use sixteen-frame clips; long-video consistency remains unestablished.

original: A step toward defining the Standard Model on a lattice

title.zh: 研究者怎样和 AI 一起推进粒子物理证明？
title.en: A step toward defining the Standard Model on a lattice

intro.zh: 把时空切成网格，可以帮助物理学家研究粒子的相互作用，而无需把这些相互作用当作很小的修正。
intro.en: Nathaniel Craig describes collaborating with Astra on a candidate lattice construction for particle physics.

zh: 把时空切成网格，可以帮助物理学家研究粒子的相互作用，而无需把这些相互作用当作很小的修正。难点之一是，网格上的力场绕一圈回到原状时，描述粒子的数学量可能累积一个额外相位。Craig 提出用一系列更细的网格计算这个修正。按他的复盘，GPT‑6 Astra 补上了如何在网格间转换、为何计算结果会收敛的论证，并主导了详细证明的推导，外部物理学家也审读并提出问题。成果仍是有限网格间距下的候选构造，连续时空下的完整理论和实际模拟还有待研究。读 Building the construction with Astra 和 What comes next。
en: Nathaniel Craig describes collaborating with Astra on a candidate lattice construction for particle physics. The model helped develop arguments about transferring between successively finer lattices and convergence, while external physicists reviewed the work. The account illustrates distinct roles for proposing a construction, developing a proof, and checking its mathematical meaning.

limits.zh: 结果仍是有限网格间距的候选构造，连续理论及实际模拟尚待研究。
limits.en: This remains a candidate construction at finite lattice spacing; the continuum theory and practical simulations need further work.

path.zh: Building the construction with Astra · What comes next
path.en: Building the construction with Astra · What comes next

original: Start and Restore GPU Workloads in Seconds with NVIDIA Snapshot

title.zh: 推理服务冷启动，为什么光加载权重还不够？
title.en: Start and Restore GPU Workloads in Seconds with NVIDIA Snapshot

intro.zh: 推理副本启动时，除了读入权重，还要准备运行缓冲区、编译 GPU 算子和捕获 CUDA 图。
intro.en: Snapshot saves initialized CPU and GPU state so compatible machines can skip repeated buffer setup, kernel compilation, and CUDA-graph capture.

zh: 推理副本启动时，除了读入权重，还要准备运行缓冲区、编译 GPU 算子和捕获 CUDA 图。Snapshot 把初始化后的 CPU 和 GPU 状态存成快照，让兼容机器跳过这些重复步骤。NVIDIA 在 8 张 B200 上用 vLLM 测试 DeepSeek‑V4.1‑Flash，报告从约 18.5 分钟降到 31 秒，代价是预先制作约 647 GB 的快照。计时不包含拉取容器镜像，恢复也要求相同的 GPU 型号和驱动。读 图 1、Methodology 和表 1。
en: Snapshot saves initialized CPU and GPU state so compatible machines can skip repeated buffer setup, kernel compilation, and CUDA-graph capture. NVIDIA reports restoring a vLLM DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash workload on eight B200s in 31 seconds instead of approximately 18.5 minutes, using a prebuilt snapshot of about 647 GB.

limits.zh: 计时不含容器拉取；恢复要求相同 GPU 型号和驱动，快照本身也有存储成本。
limits.en: Timing excludes container-image download. Restore requires matching GPUs and drivers, and the snapshot adds substantial storage cost.

original: Building strong safety evaluations

title.zh: 安全评估里，98% 和 94% 差得多吗？
title.en: Building strong safety evaluations

intro.zh: Anthropic 在一项多轮对话测试里测得两个模型的恰当回应率分别为 98% 和 94%，但差异未达到统计显著，作者因此无法判断哪个表现更好。
intro.en: Anthropic explains how paired evaluation, uncertainty estimates, and human calibration improve safety comparisons.

zh: Anthropic 在一项多轮对话测试里测得两个模型的恰当回应率分别为 98% 和 94%，但差异未达到统计显著，作者因此无法判断哪个表现更好。文章建议让两个模型回答同一组题，按题计算差异和置信区间，同时用人工标注校准自动评分器。它还给出一个容易被忽略的细节：同一模型在 API 和带产品系统提示的网页端，部分测试分数相差最高达 34 个百分点。这些数字来自 Anthropic 自己的测试配置。读其他评估报告时，也可以先看它测的是哪个版本、在哪种配置下测，以及分差有多大不确定性。读原文 Design 中的评分器校准和 Report。
en: Anthropic explains how paired evaluation, uncertainty estimates, and human calibration improve safety comparisons. In one multi-turn test, appropriate-response rates of 98% and 94% were not statistically distinguishable. Some API-versus-product configurations differed by as much as thirty-four percentage points, showing why the evaluated system configuration matters.

limits.zh: 数字来自作者特定测试；分数差不能脱离置信区间和运行配置比较。
limits.en: These are configuration-specific internal measurements. Score gaps need confidence intervals and a precise description of the evaluated system.

original: Advancing science & engineering with Antigravity’s /teamwork

title.zh: AI 参与数学研究时，怎么检查一份长证明？
title.en: Advancing science & engineering with Antigravity’s /teamwork

intro.zh: Google 的做法是让多个 Agent 并行探索候选证明，再交给 Lean 4 这样的证明检查器逐步验证。
intro.en: Google describes parallel agent exploration followed by formal checking in Lean 4.

zh: Google 的做法是让多个 Agent 并行探索候选证明，再交给 Lean 4 这样的证明检查器逐步验证。在 Courtade–Kumar 猜想的案例中，香港中文大学团队提出了把问题化为 14 变量优化的新思路，Gemini 协助划分参数空间、推导界限，团队随后用 Lean 形式化了整份证明。这里有两个不同的验证步骤：数学家确认写进 Lean 的命题确实对应原问题，Lean 再检查推导是否成立。博客展示的是成功案例，没有给出这套方法在随意选取的开放问题上的成功率。读 Scaling long-horizon reasoning 和 Courtade–Kumar 案例。
en: Google describes parallel agent exploration followed by formal checking in Lean 4. In the Courtade–Kumar case, a CUHK team reduced the problem to a fourteen-variable optimization, Gemini assisted with bounds and parameter-space partitioning, and the team formalized the proof. Mathematicians check that the formal statement matches the intended problem; Lean checks the derivation.

limits.zh: 文章为成功案例，未提供随机开放问题上的整体成功率。
limits.en: This is a successful case study, not an estimate of success over arbitrary open research problems.

path.zh: Scaling long-horizon reasoning · Courtade–Kumar case study
path.en: Scaling long-horizon reasoning · Courtade–Kumar case study

original: AURA 2.0: From User-Driven Responses to Model-Initiated Conversations in Streaming Video

title.zh: 看直播的 AI，什么时候该主动开口？
title.en: AURA 2.0: From User-Driven Responses to Model-Initiated Conversations in Streaming Video

intro.zh: AURA 2.0 逐段处理视频，每次先决定保持沉默还是回应。
intro.en: AURA 2.0 processes video incrementally and chooses whether to speak or remain silent.

zh: AURA 2.0 逐段处理视频，每次先决定保持沉默还是回应。它保留最近 30 秒的画面，把更早的事件压缩成带时间戳的文字，以便延续对话。作者在内部测试中发现，有对话背景时，模型在 25 个由人工标记的合适时段内主动开口了 20 次，整段视频中发言频率的中位数是每分钟 3 次。样本较小，回应质量主要由模型评分，研究也未验证长期使用时用户愿意被打断多少次。读 §3.1 的架构图和 §7.3 的评估。
en: AURA 2.0 processes video incrementally and chooses whether to speak or remain silent. It retains thirty seconds of recent frames and compresses older events into timestamped text. In a small internal evaluation with conversational context, it initiated responses in twenty of twenty-five human-identified windows, with a median rate of three utterances per minute.

limits.zh: 样本较小且质量主要由模型评分，未验证用户长期接受的打断频率。
limits.en: The sample is small, quality judgments are largely model-based, and acceptable interruption frequency in sustained use is untested.

original: Unbundling Multimodal Vision Encoding

title.zh: 视觉语言模型需要单独的视觉编码器吗？
title.en: Unbundling Multimodal Vision Encoding

intro.zh: 研究团队把视觉编码器的设计拆成三个问题。
intro.en: The study separates three choices in vision-language models: separate visual pretraining, image-specific parameters, and where those parameters sit.

zh: 研究团队把视觉编码器的设计拆成三个问题。图像模块是否要单独预训练？模型是否需要专门处理图像的参数？这些参数应放在图文融合之前，还是放进主干网络？在相同数据和总训练算力下，作者发现，和主干一起从头训练的视觉编码器也能取得相近的视觉问答成绩。给图像保留专用参数更有帮助，尤其是读字和读图表。把这些参数放进主干的前几层，表现也接近独立编码器。主要实验采用最高 64 亿参数的稠密主干和 224×224 图像，更高分辨率、视频输入和混合专家架构仍待验证。
en: The study separates three choices in vision-language models: separate visual pretraining, image-specific parameters, and where those parameters sit. Under matched data and compute, jointly trained encoders can reach similar visual-QA performance. Dedicated visual parameters help, particularly for text and charts, and placing them in early backbone layers can approach a standalone encoder.

limits.zh: 主要实验上限为 6.4B 稠密主干和 224×224 图片，视频及更高分辨率待验证。
limits.en: Main experiments use dense backbones up to 6.4B parameters and 224×224 images. Video, higher resolution, and MoE settings need validation.

original: Beyond Word Error Rate: A Failure Taxonomy of Streaming Dictation ASR

title.zh: 实时听写漏了一句话，可能是模型根本没收到
title.en: Beyond Word Error Rate: A Failure Taxonomy of Streaming Dictation ASR

intro.zh: 作者把相同录音以实时语速送给 11 个语音识别系统，把问题分为识别错误、输出格式、语言处理和模型前的音频丢失。
intro.en: This taxonomy distinguishes recognition mistakes from formatting, language handling, and audio discarded before inference.

zh: 作者把相同录音以实时语速送给 11 个语音识别系统，把问题分为识别错误、输出格式、语言处理和模型前的音频丢失。一个对照很直观。同一套自托管 Whisper 在一种配置下用语音活动检测器切分音频，但保留所有片段，耳语词错误率是 10.1%。让同一个检测器丢弃它判为静音的片段后，错误率升到 51.4%。这解释了为什么相近的平均错误率可能掩盖完全不同的故障。主要英文听写集来自一位朗读者，作者另外用 107 位说话者的公开录音复核了耳语现象。
en: This taxonomy distinguishes recognition mistakes from formatting, language handling, and audio discarded before inference. With the same self-hosted Whisper system and voice-activity detector, whisper error rate is 10.1% when all audio segments are retained, but 51.4% when segments labeled silent are dropped. Similar overall word error rates can conceal different system failures.

limits.zh: 主要英文听写来自一位朗读者；耳语现象另用 107 位说话者公开录音复核。
limits.en: The main English dictation set has one reader; the whispering result was additionally checked using public recordings from 107 speakers.

original: AntEmbed: Dual-Mode Multimodal Embedding Model for Efficient and Fine-Grained Retrieval

title.zh: 同一个图文索引，既能快速查，也能先分析再查
title.en: AntEmbed: Dual-Mode Multimodal Embedding Model for Efficient and Fine-Grained Retrieval

intro.zh: AntEmbed 让原始输入和补充了检索意图的输入映射到同一个向量空间，再用后者教前者保留更细的语义线索。
intro.en: AntEmbed maps direct inputs and reasoning-enriched inputs into a shared embedding space, allowing simple and complex queries to use one candidate index.

zh: AntEmbed 让原始输入和补充了检索意图的输入映射到同一个向量空间，再用后者教前者保留更细的语义线索。这样，普通查询可以直接编码，复杂查询可以先生成一段对检索意图的分析，两者共用同一套候选索引。在 MMEB‑v2 上，8B 模型的总分从直接编码的 73.1 升到推理模式的 81.5。两组都使用预先构建的推理增强候选索引，分差反映的是查询侧切换模式的收益。推理模式多了一步文本生成，评测分数本身没有衡量这一步的线上成本。
en: AntEmbed maps direct inputs and reasoning-enriched inputs into a shared embedding space, allowing simple and complex queries to use one candidate index. On MMEB-v2, the 8B model scores 73.1 in direct mode and 81.5 in reasoning mode. Both use an already reasoning-enriched candidate index, so the comparison isolates query-side mode changes.

limits.zh: 推理查询多出文本生成成本，基准总分未衡量该线上开销。
limits.en: Reasoning mode adds text-generation work; benchmark scores do not measure that online cost.

source: Institute of Tibetan Plateau Research, Chinese Academy of Sciences · collaborators
original: One2N: Recursive refinement breaks the resolution barrier for Earth-system AI

title.zh: 把全球天气预报的网格缩小十倍，要重新训练整个模型吗？
title.en: One2N: Recursive refinement breaks the resolution barrier for Earth-system AI

intro.zh: One2N 保留现有的 NeuralGCM，让它在 0.7° 网格上预测大尺度天气，再训练一个模块，学习粗网格预报与 0.07° 参考数据之间的差值。
intro.en: One2N retains a 0.7° NeuralGCM forecast and learns a residual refinement toward 0.07° reference data.

zh: One2N 保留现有的 NeuralGCM，让它在 0.7° 网格上预测大尺度天气，再训练一个模块，学习粗网格预报与 0.07° 参考数据之间的差值。作者用一张 80 GB 显卡、约四周完成了细化模块的训练。2023 年回测中，细化后的预报呈现了更多局部结构，部分上平流层变量的误差也下降了。对流层整体表现和原模型相近，热带气旋路径误差也接近原模型。网格变细和预报变准是两件需要分别测量的事。论文只验证了一层细化，长期稳定性和多层叠加效果仍待检验。
en: One2N retains a 0.7° NeuralGCM forecast and learns a residual refinement toward 0.07° reference data. The refinement module trains in about four weeks on one 80 GB GPU. In 2023 hindcasts it reveals more local structure and improves some upper-stratospheric variables, while overall tropospheric and cyclone-track results remain close to the original model.

limits.zh: 网格变细不代表整体更准；只验证一层细化，长期稳定和多层叠加待测。
limits.en: Finer resolution is not equivalent to globally higher accuracy. Only one refinement level is tested, leaving long-term stability and recursion open.

source: Fudan · PolyU · Sichuan University · Alibaba · Shanghai Jiao Tong University
original: Beyond Passive Imitation: On-Policy Mid-Training Distillation for Language Models

title.zh: 同一批数学语料，为什么一个模型学得更好，另一个反而退步？
title.en: Beyond Passive Imitation: On-Policy Mid-Training Distillation for Language Models

intro.zh: 作者让 Llama‑3.2‑3B 和 Qwen3‑1.7B 用同一批数学语料继续训练，前者在两项评测中进步，后者退步。
intro.en: Identical mathematical mid-training data can help one model and hurt another.

zh: 作者让 Llama‑3.2‑3B 和 Qwen3‑1.7B 用同一批数学语料继续训练，前者在两项评测中进步，后者退步。新方法从语料中挑出学生模型不确定的位置，让它自己续写，再由冻结的教师模型给这些续写过程提供逐词反馈。这样，学生训练时会遇到自己实际容易走到的解题路径。在 MATH‑500 上，Qwen 学生的平均单次答对率由 18.5% 升至 30.5%。对照组用了不同学习率，且结果集中在一个学生模型和两项数学评测上。
en: Identical mathematical mid-training data can help one model and hurt another. This method selects uncertain positions, lets the student generate continuations, and obtains token-level feedback from a frozen teacher along those trajectories. Qwen3-1.7B’s average single-attempt MATH-500 accuracy rises from 18.5% to 30.5% in the reported setup.

limits.zh: 对照学习率不同，结果集中在一个学生模型及两项数学评测。
limits.en: Baselines use different learning rates, and results focus on one student model and two mathematical evaluations.

original: Worse Together: How Performance Breaks Down in Multi-User Multi-Agent Teams

title.zh: 每人一个 Agent，为什么共享任务反而更难办？
title.en: Worse Together: How Performance Breaks Down in Multi-User Multi-Agent Teams

intro.zh: 团队在四种模拟场景里比较了两种安排：一名 Agent 统一协调，或每位用户各有一个 Agent、彼此发消息。
intro.en: Across four simulated shared-resource scenarios, one coordinating agent scores above separate agents acting for individual users for both tested Claude models.

zh: 团队在四种模拟场景里比较了两种安排：一名 Agent 统一协调，或每位用户各有一个 Agent、彼此发消息。对两款受测 Claude 模型，统一协调在四个场景中的团体得分均更高。团体订餐尤其直观：在 94%–99% 的回合中，关键请求发给了最终下单的 Agent，但下单时只有 47%–67% 的回合里，这条请求已进入它的上下文。等待消息读完再提交，能挽回部分失败。这个实验测的是不同用户争用共享资源，团体得分也可能漏掉未经同意取消他人任务等行为。
en: Across four simulated shared-resource scenarios, one coordinating agent scores above separate agents acting for individual users for both tested Claude models. In group food ordering, critical requests are sent in 94%–99% of rounds but reach the ordering agent’s context before submission in only 47%–67%. Waiting for messages recovers some failures.

limits.zh: 测试针对共享资源；团体得分可能漏掉未经同意取消他人任务等行为。
limits.en: The setting concerns shared resources, and group scores can miss behaviors such as canceling another user’s task without consent.

original: Learning Heterogeneous Tactile Representation for General Dexterous Manipulation

title.zh: 不同传感器采到的「手感」，能用同一个模型学吗？
title.en: Learning Heterogeneous Tactile Representation for General Dexterous Manipulation

intro.zh: 同一次指尖接触，压阻传感器记录电阻变化，磁传感器记录磁场变化，视触觉传感器则拍下材料形变。
intro.en: LingBot-Touch maps heterogeneous tactile sensors into a common fingertip coordinate system and learns a shared encoder from about 5,000 hours of data.

zh: 同一次指尖接触，压阻传感器记录电阻变化，磁传感器记录磁场变化，视触觉传感器则拍下材料形变。LingBot‑Touch 先把不同传感器的测量位置映射到统一的指尖坐标，再用约 5,000 小时的触觉数据训练一个共享编码器。训练时遮住部分信号，让模型预测缺失部分的特征，因此无需人工逐帧标注接触位置或力度。
在五项真机任务中，同一动作模型加入触觉特征后，作者报告平均得分从 55.9% 升到 82.2%。评分会给已完成的步骤部分分数。实验覆盖两种机械手，预训练主要覆盖指尖，手掌接触和电容式传感器仍待验证。
en: LingBot-Touch maps heterogeneous tactile sensors into a common fingertip coordinate system and learns a shared encoder from about 5,000 hours of data. Masked prediction avoids frame-by-frame contact labels. Adding tactile features raises the authors’ average score on five real-robot tasks from 55.9% to 82.2% under the same action-model setup.

limits.zh: 分数包含步骤部分分；只测两种机械手，手掌及电容式触觉待验证。
limits.en: Scores include partial credit. Tests cover two robot hands; palm contact and capacitive sensors remain unvalidated.

original: Decision Models in Hugging Face

title.zh: 给定选项后，模型可以直接打分
title.en: Decision Models in Hugging Face

intro.zh: 如果系统只需要判断一条客服请求该转给谁、是否紧急、是否要求退款，模型可以直接对这些答案打分，省去逐词生成回复再解析的过程。
intro.en: Decision-model interfaces score user-defined answer options directly instead of generating text and parsing it.

zh: 如果系统只需要判断一条客服请求该转给谁、是否紧急、是否要求退款，模型可以直接对这些答案打分，省去逐词生成回复再解析的过程。文章介绍的接口允许每次请求定义选项，并对同一份输入同时提多个问题，例如选类别、评等级和做是非判断。
这种接口也能用在兼容的生成模型上。Transformers 可以批量计算候选标签的分数，再把它们转换成概率。文章演示了接口和训练方式，概率是否能反映真实正确率，仍需用有标签的样本验证。
en: Decision-model interfaces score user-defined answer options directly instead of generating text and parsing it. One input can support several questions, such as routing, urgency, and refund intent. Compatible generative models can also score candidate labels in batches and convert scores to probabilities.

limits.zh: 文章演示接口与训练方式；输出概率是否校准仍需有标签数据验证。
limits.en: The article demonstrates interfaces and training patterns. Probability calibration still requires validation on labeled examples.

path.zh: Where decision models differ · The decision model interface
path.en: Where decision models differ · The decision model interface

original: MV-IVF: Multi-Vector Retrieval via Multi-Vector Clustering

title.zh: 一篇文档有几十个向量，怎么快速找到它？
title.en: MV-IVF: Multi-Vector Retrieval via Multi-Vector Clustering

intro.zh: 多向量检索允许查询里的不同词分别匹配文档里的不同位置，代价是每次比较需要计算更多向量。
intro.en: MV-IVF groups documents as sets of vectors and summarizes each group with representative vectors.

zh: 多向量检索允许查询里的不同词分别匹配文档里的不同位置，代价是每次比较需要计算更多向量。MV‑IVF 把文档按向量集合分组，并用一小组代表向量描述每个分组。查询沿着分组树找到有希望的分支，再给其中的文档打分。
在恢复精确排名前 10 项的 90% 这一条件下，论文报告，相对三种主要基线，批量吞吐的几何平均提升为 2.07–4.01 倍。这个召回率衡量的是对精确向量排名的还原程度。提前停止搜索也依赖启发式规则，少搜一些分支可能漏掉候选。
en: MV-IVF groups documents as sets of vectors and summarizes each group with representative vectors. Search follows promising branches before scoring individual documents. At 90% recall of the exact top-ten vector ranking, reported geometric-mean batched throughput gains are 2.07–4.01× over three primary baselines.

limits.zh: 此召回率衡量向量排名还原，提前停止依赖启发式并可能漏候选。
limits.en: Recall measures recovery of the exact vector ranking, not answer quality. Heuristic early stopping can miss candidates.

original: Beyond Modality Preference: Controlling Multimodal Arbitration under Modality Conflict in MLLMs

title.zh: 图片和文字互相矛盾，模型会信谁？
title.en: Beyond Modality Preference: Controlling Multimodal Arbitration under Modality Conflict in MLLMs

intro.zh: 一张图表显示销量下降，旁边的文字却说销量上升。
intro.en: When images and text conflict, a vision-language model may follow the text even if instructed otherwise.

zh: 一张图表显示销量下降，旁边的文字却说销量上升。即使提示词写了「以图为准」，视觉语言模型也可能跟着文字回答。研究团队从模型的注意力头中找出一小组会影响这种选择的头，在推理时调整它们对图像和文字的注意力，无需重新训练。
在 MC² 评测上，指定图像优先后，Qwen3‑VL‑8B 给出图像支持答案的比例从 47.25% 升到 79.50%。这个数字衡量的是模型能否遵循指定的证据优先级。实验由外部指定哪类证据可信，两边都只对了一部分、需要综合判断的情况仍待验证。
en: When images and text conflict, a vision-language model may follow the text even if instructed otherwise. The study identifies a small set of influential attention heads and adjusts their image-versus-text attention during inference. On MC², Qwen3-VL-8B’s image-supported answer rate rises from 47.25% to 79.50% when visual evidence is designated authoritative.

limits.zh: 可信证据由外部指定，尚未解决图文各自部分正确时的综合判断。
limits.en: Evidence priority is supplied externally. Cases requiring integration of partly correct modalities remain open.

original: Large Language Models as a Universal Searcher for Open-World Automated Machine Learning

title.zh: 让语言模型挑选下一组训练配置
title.en: Large Language Models as a Universal Searcher for Open-World Automated Machine Learning

intro.zh: 调整模型结构时，原本合适的学习率和数据配比也可能要变。
intro.en: NCode encodes architecture and training choices as numerical sequences so a language model can select promising candidates from past experiment results.

zh: 调整模型结构时，原本合适的学习率和数据配比也可能要变。作者用 NCode 把这些选项统一编码成数字序列，让语言模型根据之前的实验结果，从一批候选里挑出值得试的组合。搜索器从图像分类的历史实验中学习，作者随后把它用于图像分割、说话人验证和文生图，无需为这些任务重新微调搜索器。
实际搜索仍要训练候选模型来打分。文生图实验先用更浅、更窄的模型跑短训练，再把选出的配置用于正式训练。这个设计把成本压在较小的试验上，也让结果依赖一个条件：短跑表现得能反映正式训练的潜力。
en: NCode encodes architecture and training choices as numerical sequences so a language model can select promising candidates from past experiment results. A searcher learned on image classification is applied to segmentation, speaker verification, and text-to-image generation without task-specific retraining. Candidate configurations still require actual training and scoring.

limits.zh: 短训练代理节省成本，但其排名未必反映完整训练的潜力。
limits.en: Short proxy runs reduce search cost, but their rankings must predict the potential of full training.

original: Spectral Rank and Step-Direction Dynamics in Language-Model Post-Training

title.zh: 后训练的权重变化，到底有多「低秩」？
title.en: Spectral Rank and Step-Direction Dynamics in Language-Model Post-Training

intro.zh: 作者发现，同一次权重变化可以同时满足两种描述：少数主方向特别强，但要保留大部分变化，仍需要许多较弱的方向。
intro.en: A weight update can have a few dominant directions while still needing many weaker components to preserve most of its energy.

zh: 作者发现，同一次权重变化可以同时满足两种描述：少数主方向特别强，但要保留大部分变化，仍需要许多较弱的方向。在 OLMo‑2‑7B 的三个注意力权重更新里，衡量主方向集中程度的「稳定秩」只有 9.6–18.3，保留 80% 的矩阵能量却需要 532–1,222 个分量。
论文还观察到，九个公开强化学习训练阶段中，131 对相邻的检查点更新方向都呈负相关。这些方向来自两次存档之间累积的权重变化，观察结果取决于存档间隔和训练配置。哪些较弱的方向影响任务表现，还需要实际截断权重后再测。
en: A weight update can have a few dominant directions while still needing many weaker components to preserve most of its energy. Three OLMo-2-7B attention updates have stable rank 9.6–18.3 but require 532–1,222 components for 80% energy. The authors also find negative correlation for 131 adjacent checkpoint-update pairs across nine public RL stages.

limits.zh: 观察依赖检查点间隔；弱方向的功能作用还需截断权重后实测。
limits.en: Observations depend on checkpoint spacing and training setup. Functional effects of weaker directions require intervention experiments.

original: GR00T 2: Scaling Robot Foundation Models for Generalization, Dexterity, and Adaptation

title.zh: 机器人能从人类视频里学到多少？
title.en: GR00T 2: Scaling Robot Foundation Models for Generalization, Dexterity, and Adaptation

intro.zh: GR00T 2 同时预测机器人接下来要做的动作和动作之后的画面。
intro.en: GR00T 2 jointly predicts robot actions and resulting observations, learning from human first-person video, handheld-gripper demonstrations, and robot teleoperation.

zh: GR00T 2 同时预测机器人接下来要做的动作和动作之后的画面。它把人类第一视角视频、手持夹爪示范和机器人遥操作混在一起训练。人类视频可以提供物体如何移动、任务如何推进的线索，机器人数据则让模型学会如何用具体的机械结构执行动作。
在目标双臂机器人没练过的 50 项任务中，NVIDIA 报告零样本的试次成功率为 40%，其中 40 项任务至少成功过一次。每项加入五次示范并微调后，试次成功率升到 95%。这些任务曾出现在人类视频或其他机器人的数据里，因此这里测的是跨机器人迁移。
en: GR00T 2 jointly predicts robot actions and resulting observations, learning from human first-person video, handheld-gripper demonstrations, and robot teleoperation. On fifty tasks unseen by the target dual-arm robot, NVIDIA reports 40% zero-shot trial success, with at least one success on forty tasks. Five demonstrations per task raise trial success to 95% after adaptation.

limits.zh: 任务曾见于人类视频或其他机器人数据，这里衡量跨机器人迁移。
limits.en: Tasks had appeared in human or other-robot data; this measures transfer to the target robot rather than wholly unseen task concepts.

path.zh: Model Architecture · Scaling Human Video in Pretraining · Fast Adaptation
path.en: Model Architecture · Scaling Human Video in Pretraining · Fast Adaptation

original: Same Logic, Different Words: Why AI Systems Contradict Themselves, and What We Did About It

title.zh: 同一条逻辑规则，换个说法为什么会改变答案？
title.en: Same Logic, Different Words: Why AI Systems Contradict Themselves, and What We Did About It

intro.zh: 研究团队把 1,500 道逻辑题改写成含义相同的版本，例如用「并非两项都不满足」表达「至少满足一项」。
intro.en: Researchers rewrite 1,500 logical questions into equivalent forms and compare answer stability against repeated original questions.

zh: 研究团队把 1,500 道逻辑题改写成含义相同的版本，例如用「并非两项都不满足」表达「至少满足一项」。在最难的一组改写中，o3 有 37% 的题改变了判断。团队还用原题重复提问，估计模型自身的随机波动。
他们将规则转成按条件分支的决策图，再训练模型把图的编码和原文一起读。在两种训练设置下，改写导致的答案变动率从 30% 以上降到约 15%。这组实验把答得对和换种说法仍能答得一致分开测量。验证主要集中在可形式化的逻辑题，带有模糊措辞和例外的规则仍需单独验证。
en: Researchers rewrite 1,500 logical questions into equivalent forms and compare answer stability against repeated original questions. On the hardest rewrites, o3 changes its judgment on 37% of questions. Training a model to read a decision-diagram representation alongside the rule reduces rewrite-induced changes from above 30% to about 15% in two training setups.

limits.zh: 主要覆盖可形式化逻辑，模糊规则与例外仍需验证；来源为作者研究解读。
limits.en: Evidence focuses on formalizable logic, leaving ambiguous language and exceptions open. The source is an author-written research explanation.

path.en: Free-shipping example · Giving the model a map

original: SpecCTMC: Exact Speculative Simulation of Diffusion Language Model Continuous-Time Markov Chains

title.zh: 扩散语言模型如何并行填词，又保留词与词之间的依赖？
title.en: SpecCTMC: Exact Speculative Simulation of Diffusion Language Model Continuous-Time Markov Chains

intro.zh: 扩散语言模型可以从一串空位开始填词。
intro.en: SpecCTMC proposes a sequence of token-filling events for a diffusion language model, evaluates candidates in parallel, then accepts them sequentially.

zh: 扩散语言模型可以从一串空位开始填词。若多个位置各自独立填入，先填的词就无法影响后填的词。SpecCTMC 先拟定一串填词动作，让模型批量计算这些候选，再按顺序验收。第一次拒绝时，算法按修正后的概率重抽，并从新状态继续。作者证明，在论文设定下，这保留了逐步采样的概率分布。
两款文本模型的串行调用轮数降到原来的约 23%–58%。但一次调用需要同时算多个候选，论文的长提示测试中有些配置反而更慢。
en: SpecCTMC proposes a sequence of token-filling events for a diffusion language model, evaluates candidates in parallel, then accepts them sequentially. A rejected event is resampled using corrected probabilities. Under the paper’s assumptions this preserves the target stepwise distribution. Serial model-call counts fall to roughly 23%–58% of baseline for two text models.

limits.zh: 每次调用需算多个候选；长提示下部分配置实际更慢。
limits.en: Each call processes multiple candidates; some long-prompt configurations are slower in wall-clock time despite fewer serial calls.

original: Measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science

title.zh: AI 能判断实验数据支持什么结论吗？
title.en: Measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science

intro.zh: BioBasicsBench 用实验人员提供的原始数据设计了 100 道题。
intro.en: BioBasicsBench contains one hundred questions grounded in raw wet-lab data, including microscopy, plates, and instrument readings.

zh: BioBasicsBench 用实验人员提供的原始数据设计了 100 道题。模型要看显微图、培养皿照片和仪器读数，既要给出判断，也要识别证据不足的情况。在相同的 xhigh 推理设置下，GPT‑6 Astra 平均拿到 66.7% 的可用分值，GPT‑5.6 Sol 为 43.8%。这是按评分条目计算的平均得分。
两个案例适合对照着读。一次，Astra 从培养皿边缘的标签发现对照组用了不同的抗生素。另一次，它虽然分对了图像里的条带，却用自己对产物大小的假设压过了实验对照，最后选错样本。评测覆盖的是给定材料后的分析判断，实际操作和完整实验流程在其范围之外。
en: BioBasicsBench contains one hundred questions grounded in raw wet-lab data, including microscopy, plates, and instrument readings. Models must interpret evidence and recognize insufficiency. With matched xhigh reasoning settings, the authors report 66.7% of available rubric credit for Astra and 43.8% for Sol. Cases illustrate both useful control detection and unsupported assumptions overriding controls.

limits.zh: 评估给定材料后的分析判断，不覆盖实际操作或完整实验流程。
limits.en: The benchmark evaluates interpretation of supplied materials, not physical execution or end-to-end laboratory research.

original: ProQuant: Progressive Quantization-aware Training for Edge MLLMs

title.zh: 把视觉语言模型压到低精度，哪些层应该先适应？
title.en: ProQuant: Progressive Quantization-aware Training for Edge MLLMs

intro.zh: 低比特量化用更少的位数表示模型权重和计算中间值。
intro.en: ProQuant progressively adapts visually sensitive layers to quantization error before including other layers, while refreshing training answers with the original model.

zh: 低比特量化用更少的位数表示模型权重和计算中间值。ProQuant 在微调中优先让对视觉输入敏感的层适应量化误差，再逐步加入其他层，同时用原模型重新生成训练样本的答案。Qwen3‑VL‑2B 在七项评测中的平均分，使用 4 位权重、8 位中间值时为 72.54，接近 BF16 的 73.63。把中间值也降到 4 位，均分降到 59.83。表 1 还显示，部分任务的降幅比均分更明显。实验覆盖的模型最大为 80 亿参数，更大的模型和不同架构仍待验证。
en: ProQuant progressively adapts visually sensitive layers to quantization error before including other layers, while refreshing training answers with the original model. Across seven evaluations, Qwen3-VL-2B averages 72.54 with four-bit weights and eight-bit activations, versus 73.63 in BF16. Four-bit activations reduce the average to 59.83.

limits.zh: 均分掩盖部分任务更大降幅；模型最大为 8B，其他规模架构待测。
limits.en: Averages hide larger task-specific drops. Experiments cover models up to 8B parameters; other scales and architectures need testing.

original: Egyptian and Nigerian English join the Open ASR Leaderboard

title.zh: 语音识别排行榜加入了两种英语口音
title.en: Egyptian and Nigerian English join the Open ASR Leaderboard

intro.zh: Open ASR Leaderboard 加入埃及英语和尼日利亚英语的非公开测试集，分别约 1.34 和 1.55 小时。
intro.en: The Open ASR Leaderboard adds private Egyptian-English and Nigerian-English conversational test sets of about 1.34 and 1.55 hours.

zh: Open ASR Leaderboard 加入埃及英语和尼日利亚英语的非公开测试集，分别约 1.34 和 1.55 小时。两组都是自然对话，转录保留了口语中的不流畅现象。使用非公开样本是为了降低模型针对已知测试集调优的机会，按口音组别报告则能看到总分可能掩盖的差异。两组样本的时长都有限，文章介绍的是评测覆盖面的变化，具体模型在不同口音上的差距还需看分组结果。
en: The Open ASR Leaderboard adds private Egyptian-English and Nigerian-English conversational test sets of about 1.34 and 1.55 hours. Transcripts retain disfluencies. Private examples reduce opportunities to tune directly to public tests, while per-accent reporting exposes differences that an aggregate score can hide.

limits.zh: 两组时长有限；文章介绍评测覆盖变化，具体差距需看分组成绩。
limits.en: Both sets are small. The article describes broader evaluation coverage; model-specific differences require the subgroup results.

original: Localization Does Not Imply Steerability: A Mechanistic Study of Sign Errors in LLM Mathematics

title.zh: 找到模型写错负号的位置，能修好吗？
title.en: Localization Does Not Imply Steerability: A Mechanistic Study of Sign Errors in LLM Mathematics

intro.zh: 模型有时会在行列式展开或分部积分里写错一个正负号，后面却一直算对。
intro.en: The researchers localize sign mistakes in two types of mathematical tasks across five models.

zh: 模型有时会在行列式展开或分部积分里写错一个正负号，后面却一直算对。作者对五个模型做了完整的定位与干预实验，发现正负号大多在网络后段定下来，而且正确和错误的符号往往由同一批层写出。削弱这些层中偏向负号的信号，在 Llama 的一组分部积分留出样本里翻转了 14 个错误负号中的 13 个，在 Phi-4 上却几乎不起作用。同样的干预也会翻转部分原本正确的负号。读图 1 和图 3 时，可以分别看「哪一层影响输出」和「改动这一层能否提高正确率」。实验只覆盖两类数学题，主要在符号输出的位置评分。
en: The researchers localize sign mistakes in two types of mathematical tasks across five models. Correct and incorrect signs often originate in the same late layers. Suppressing negative-sign signals corrects thirteen of fourteen held-out Llama errors in one integration task, but has little effect on Phi-4 and also flips some originally correct signs.

limits.zh: 定位到输出相关层并不意味着能可靠修正，实验范围仅两类数学题。
limits.en: Localizing influential layers does not establish reliable control. Experiments cover only two mathematical task families.

original: The components of agent memory

title.zh: Agent 的跨会话记忆，怎么纠正记错的内容？
title.en: The components of agent memory

intro.zh: 文章把记忆拆成四层：原始记录、随手笔记、整理过的 Wiki，以及新会话启动时自动加载的少量信息。
intro.en: The article separates raw records, scratch notes, curated wiki pages, and a small startup context.

zh: 文章把记忆拆成四层：原始记录、随手笔记、整理过的 Wiki，以及新会话启动时自动加载的少量信息。会话结束后，Agent 可以回看原始记录，纠正错误笔记或合并重复页面，作者称这一步为 *dreaming*。在一组包含 25 道题的内部文档评估中，Wiki 加原文搜索满足了 61% 的评分条目，仅搜索为 53%，仅 Wiki 的最好成绩为 48%。这个对照说明，在该任务里 Wiki 帮模型找到线索，原文搜索仍提供了不少关键信息。整理和校验本身也消耗算力。
en: The article separates raw records, scratch notes, curated wiki pages, and a small startup context. A consolidation phase revisits records to correct errors and merge duplicates. In a twenty-five-question internal-document evaluation, wiki plus original-source search satisfies 61% of rubric criteria, compared with 53% for search alone and a best 48% for wiki alone.

limits.zh: 内部评估规模小，记忆整理和校验另有算力成本。
limits.en: The internal evaluation is small. Memory consolidation and verification introduce additional computation.

original: FlashOffloading: Low-Latency KV Cache Offloading for Long-Context LLM Serving

title.zh: 把长上下文缓存搬到主机内存，为什么吞吐反而能提高？
title.en: FlashOffloading: Low-Latency KV Cache Offloading for Long-Context LLM Serving

intro.zh: KV 缓存保存历史 token 的注意力中间结果，避免模型每生成一个词元就把前文重算一遍。
intro.en: FlashOffloading stores the full KV cache in host memory, overlapping future-layer transfers with current-layer computation during input processing.

zh: KV 缓存保存历史 token 的注意力中间结果，避免模型每生成一个词元就把前文重算一遍。FlashOffloading 把完整缓存放在主机内存中。处理输入时，计算当前层的同时搬运后续层的数据。生成输出时，利用模型的稀疏注意力，只取当前需要的缓存条目。作者在 GLM-5.2 和昇腾 910C 的一组配置中报告，生成吞吐最高达到仅卸载输入阶段缓存时的 1.91 倍。收益来自能同时服务更多请求，单个请求生成每个词元反而更慢。
en: FlashOffloading stores the full KV cache in host memory, overlapping future-layer transfers with current-layer computation during input processing. During generation, sparse attention fetches only selected entries. For a GLM-5.2 configuration on Ascend 910C, the authors report up to 1.91× generation throughput relative to input-stage-only offloading.

limits.zh: 收益来自更大并发，单请求每词元生成反而更慢，依赖硬件和稀疏模式。
limits.en: Higher throughput comes from serving more requests concurrently; per-request token generation is slower. Gains depend on hardware and attention sparsity.

original: Detecting signs of hypertension using wearable sensors

title.zh: 从日常传感器信号中学习健康特征
title.en: Detecting signs of hypertension using wearable sensors

intro.zh: 这项研究尝试用手表的光学脉搏和加速度信号，识别持续性高血压风险。
intro.en: The study uses self-supervised learning on optical pulse and acceleration signals, then aggregates features across days for logistic-regression risk screening.

zh: 这项研究尝试用手表的光学脉搏和加速度信号，识别持续性高血压风险。方法是先通过自监督学习，从大量没有疾病标签的波形中学习特征；再把多个日子的特征汇总，用简单分类器判断风险，减少运动等短时噪声的影响。
值得了解的是：复杂模型负责提取特征，最终判断仍可以交给逻辑回归。研究者在 196 人的前瞻性研究中，报告初筛敏感度 65.8%、特异度 90%，意味着仍会漏掉部分病例；参与者也不包括服用降压药的人群。它展示了筛查潜力，尚不足以替代标准血压测量。
en: The study uses self-supervised learning on optical pulse and acceleration signals, then aggregates features across days for logistic-regression risk screening. In a prospective study of 196 participants, the authors report 65.8% sensitivity at 90% specificity for an initial hypertension screen. Multi-day aggregation reduces sensitivity to short-term motion noise.

limits.zh: 排除服降压药人群，仍会漏检；研究不能替代标准血压测量。
limits.en: Participants taking antihypertensive medication were excluded. Missed cases remain, and the study does not establish a replacement for standard blood-pressure measurement.

original: New NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Open Models for Interactive World Simulation

title.zh: 世界模型怎样持续响应动作？
title.en: New NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Open Models for Interactive World Simulation

intro.zh: 文章介绍四个开放权重模型，分别面向驾驶场景、多传感器观测、模拟器画面和双臂机器人。
intro.en: Cosmos 3 models generate observations in chunks conditioned on actions and prior frames, supporting driving and robot-simulation settings.

zh: 文章介绍四个开放权重模型，分别面向驾驶场景、多传感器观测、模拟器画面和双臂机器人。重点是分段生成：模型根据动作和已有画面生成下一小段，再接受新的控制输入。
训练中有个关键问题：使用真实历史训练的模型，运行时却必须面对自己生成的历史，错误容易累积。团队先进行少步蒸馏以降低生成成本，再让模型用自己生成的历史继续训练，适应这种偏差。
值得注意其系统边界：部分方案仍由物理模拟器计算运动和接触，模型生成视觉观测。画面逼真程度，也不足以证明模拟环境能可靠评估真实机器人。
en: Cosmos 3 models generate observations in chunks conditioned on actions and prior frames, supporting driving and robot-simulation settings. Few-step distillation lowers generation cost, followed by training on self-generated history to address accumulated prediction error. The system is designed to accept new controls between generated segments.

limits.zh: 部分方案仍靠物理模拟器计算接触和运动，画面逼真不等于物理可靠。
limits.en: Some configurations rely on a conventional simulator for motion and contact. Visual realism alone does not validate physical or robot-evaluation reliability.

original: USDB: Scaling Storage for Next-Generation Recommender Systems at ByteDance

title.zh: 推荐模型变大，数据系统也要一起改变
title.en: USDB: Scaling Storage for Next-Generation Recommender Systems at ByteDance

intro.zh: 推荐模型开始读取更长的用户行为历史，带来两种冲突：持续写入少量新行为，同时反复读取大量历史。
intro.en: USDB addresses continual small writes and repeated large historical reads in recommendation systems with background aggregation, shared storage, and column-selective access.

zh: 推荐模型开始读取更长的用户行为历史，带来两种冲突：持续写入少量新行为，同时反复读取大量历史。USDB 通过后台聚合、共享存储和按需读取特征列，减少重复处理。
更值得读的是训练数据的时间边界：某个行为虽然早已发生，却可能很晚才到达系统。重建训练样本时，如果只按事件时间筛选，就会加入模型当时根本没看到的信息。论文用版本信息保留“当时可见的数据”，避免信息泄漏。
en: USDB addresses continual small writes and repeated large historical reads in recommendation systems with background aggregation, shared storage, and column-selective access. Versioning reconstructs what data was actually visible at a historical prediction time, preventing late-arriving events from leaking into training examples. The authors report 42.1% lower infrastructure cost under their deployment accounting.

limits.zh: 系统成本收益不等于推荐质量提升，取决于部署负载与核算口径。
limits.en: Infrastructure savings do not imply a corresponding recommendation-quality gain and depend on workload and accounting assumptions.

original: T-Rex: Tactile-Reactive Dexterous Manipulation

title.zh: 机器人怎样做到“看得慢一点，触觉反应快一点”？
title.en: T-Rex: Tactile-Reactive Dexterous Manipulation

intro.zh: 拿鸡蛋、翻书、拔出卡片，都需要接触后及时调整力度。
intro.en: T-Rex combines visual-language action planning at roughly 5 Hz with tactile corrections at about 20 Hz, reusing visual computation between contact updates.

zh: 拿鸡蛋、翻书、拔出卡片，都需要接触后及时调整力度。T-Rex 将视觉与语言驱动的整体动作规划，和更高频的触觉修正结合：前者约每秒更新五次，后者约二十次，修正时复用已有视觉计算。
值得了解的是：不同感知信号可以按不同频率进入控制回路，不必每次接触变化都重新运行整套视觉模型。研究还结合人类视频预训练与一百小时触觉同步机器人数据。
作者报告十二项任务平均成功率为 65%，最强基线为 35%。局限包括任务与硬件范围有限、传感器校准漂移，以及复杂长任务中仍会滑落、碰撞或放置不准。
en: T-Rex combines visual-language action planning at roughly 5 Hz with tactile corrections at about 20 Hz, reusing visual computation between contact updates. It combines human-video pretraining with one hundred hours of tactile-synchronized robot data. The authors report 65% average success on twelve tasks, versus 35% for the strongest baseline.

limits.zh: 任务硬件有限，校准漂移及长任务失败仍存在；十一月介绍并非论文首次发布。
limits.en: Tasks and hardware are limited; calibration drift and long-task failures remain. The November announcement is distinct from the paper’s June submission.

original: A Closer Look at Phonon TTS. Launching High-Quality On-Device Speech That Tops the Benchmarks.

title.zh: 很小的模型，如何在设备上开口说话？
title.en: A Closer Look at Phonon TTS. Launching High-Quality On-Device Speech That Tops the Benchmarks.

intro.zh: Phonon 延续 Pocket TTS 路线，逐步生成压缩的音频表示，再解码成声音。
intro.en: Phonon follows the Pocket TTS approach, generating compressed audio representations before decoding speech.

zh: Phonon 延续 Pocket TTS 路线，逐步生成压缩的音频表示，再解码成声音。可以把音频编解码器理解为：为语音生成提供模型能够处理的表示，作用类似文本系统里的分词器。
文章还区分两种执行目标：设备上的单路实时播放，以及 GPU 上的批量生成。模型大小、首段声音延迟和批量吞吐，是不同的优化指标。
团队报告其在部分语言与 CPU 流式测试中表现突出，但榜单结果不能代表所有设备、口音和长文本表现。当前小版本支持英语，多语言版本覆盖五种语言；各版本许可也不同。
en: Phonon follows the Pocket TTS approach, generating compressed audio representations before decoding speech. The article distinguishes single-stream playback on a device from batched GPU generation, showing why model size, first-audio latency, and aggregate throughput are different optimization targets. Smaller and multilingual variants support different language sets.

limits.zh: 设备口音长文本效果不能由部分榜单推定；不同版本许可也不同。
limits.en: Selected benchmarks do not establish performance across devices, accents, and long texts. Licenses differ between variants.

original: A thousand fewer paths to root

title.zh: 得到成功结果，还要核查成功的原因
title.en: A thousand fewer paths to root

intro.zh: OpenAI 介绍了一套从漏洞候选发现、隔离环境复现，到候选补丁生成与人工审核的流程，并报告在受控 Linux 环境中验证了大量问题。
intro.en: The article describes finding candidate vulnerabilities, reproducing them in isolated Linux environments, and proposing patches for human review.

zh: OpenAI 介绍了一套从漏洞候选发现、隔离环境复现，到候选补丁生成与人工审核的流程，并报告在受控 Linux 环境中验证了大量问题。
最值得关注的是验证方法：早期部分任务虽然成功取得目标权限，实际却利用了另一处漏洞，团队因此增加独立检查。结果达标，并不自动证明任务沿预期路径完成。
文章也承认，初始补丁可能遗漏变体、增加不必要代码或引入性能取舍。报告中的发现数量与候选补丁，不能直接理解为同等数量的问题已经全部修复上线。
en: The article describes finding candidate vulnerabilities, reproducing them in isolated Linux environments, and proposing patches for human review. Some early attempts reached the target privilege through a different vulnerability than intended, prompting independent path validation. The case shows why attaining an outcome does not by itself verify the expected causal route.

limits.zh: 候选补丁可能漏变体或引入性能取舍，发现数量不代表全部修复上线。
limits.en: Candidate patches can miss variants or introduce complexity and performance tradeoffs. Reported findings are not equivalent to deployed fixes.

path.en: Human review · Path validation · Patch iteration

original: StateBench: Testing how language models track state changes over long documents

title.zh: 记住一条信息，与跟踪它怎样变化，是两种能力
title.en: StateBench: Testing how language models track state changes over long documents

intro.zh: “找到某人的出生日期”只需定位固定信息；“某件物品被多次转交后在谁手里”，则需要连续更新状态。
intro.en: StateBench distinguishes retrieving a fixed value from tracking overwrites, accumulated updates, and dependencies across variables.

zh: “找到某人的出生日期”只需定位固定信息；“某件物品被多次转交后在谁手里”，则需要连续更新状态。StateBench 将这些任务按难度分层，区分固定赋值、覆盖旧值、累积更新和跨变量依赖。
作者发现，部分循环与混合架构经过专门训练后，能向更长序列泛化；但预训练模型并不会自动获得这种能力，题目换一种表达格式，成绩也可能明显变化。
值得了解的是：上下文窗口长度，只说明能容纳多少输入；状态跟踪还取决于训练和计算机制。 局限是测试使用固定数量的变量，尚未覆盖真实对话中不断出现新人物、新对象的情况。
en: StateBench distinguishes retrieving a fixed value from tracking overwrites, accumulated updates, and dependencies across variables. Some recurrent and hybrid architectures trained for the task generalize to longer sequences, but pretrained models do not acquire this automatically and scores can shift when input formatting changes. Context capacity and state-tracking ability need separate measurement.

limits.zh: 变量数固定，未覆盖真实对话中持续出现新对象的情况。
limits.en: Tasks use a fixed number of variables rather than the continual introduction of new entities found in real conversations.

original: Agentic cheminformatics with Google Antigravity

title.zh: 语言模型与化学工具怎样分工？
title.en: Agentic cheminformatics with Google Antigravity

intro.zh: 同一个分子可能以名称、结构图片或数据文件出现，科学家需要先统一表示，再关联实验数据。
intro.en: The workflow combines literature retrieval, compound standardization, analysis tools, and predictive modeling.

zh: 同一个分子可能以名称、结构图片或数据文件出现，科学家需要先统一表示，再关联实验数据。文章展示了一个工作流：模型检索文献、整理化合物、调用分析工具，并协助构建预测模型。
核心设计是：语言模型组织流程，RDKit 等确定性工具执行分子计算。 评估时还考虑按时间或分子骨架划分数据，检查预测能力能否迁移到较陌生的化合物。
这是一份技术演示。作者称流程可在约一小时内提出设计假设，但数据稀疏、实验室间测量差异都会限制预测精度；候选设计仍需实验验证。
en: The workflow combines literature retrieval, compound standardization, analysis tools, and predictive modeling. Language models organize the process while deterministic chemistry software such as RDKit performs molecular calculations. Time-based and scaffold-based splits test whether predictions extend beyond familiar compounds. The article reports generating design hypotheses in about an hour.

limits.zh: 技术演示仍受稀疏数据与实验室差异限制，候选分子需实验验证。
limits.en: This is a technical demonstration constrained by sparse data and cross-laboratory measurement differences. Proposed designs need experimental validation.

original: MOPD: how frontier labs merge RL experts into one model and how to do it using TRL

title.zh: 让一个学生向多位专家学习
title.en: MOPD: how frontier labs merge RL experts into one model and how to do it using TRL

intro.zh: MOPD 先分别训练数学、代码等领域的专家，再让学生模型自己生成回答，由对应专家提供逐词元的概率反馈。
intro.en: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation trains specialists separately, then lets a student generate trajectories and receive token-level feedback from the relevant expert.

zh: MOPD 先分别训练数学、代码等领域的专家，再让学生模型自己生成回答，由对应专家提供逐词元的概率反馈。“On-policy”强调学生从自己的生成轨迹中学习，这样也能接触自己容易走偏的位置。
一个很实用的细节是：题目比例不等于训练贡献。数学回答很长，可能占据多数训练词元，让短回答领域得到的学习信号过少。
文章提供了 TRL 实现和短实验，但只有 60 个训练步骤，不能据此判断完整训练收益；专家质量、反馈形式与领域平衡仍需验证。
en: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation trains specialists separately, then lets a student generate trajectories and receive token-level feedback from the relevant expert. The article’s TRL example highlights that task proportions are not token proportions: long mathematical answers can dominate the training signal over shorter tasks.

limits.zh: 署名技术解读和实现示例仅六十步，不能据此判断完整训练收益。
limits.en: This is an attributed explanation and implementation example with only sixty training steps, not evidence of full-run training gains.

path.en: Method overview · Watching the token imbalance

original: Transformers Model Integration Contracts

title.zh: 模型能正常运行，也可能悄悄算错
title.en: Transformers Model Integration Contracts

intro.zh: 文章从一个真实回归讲起：注意力实现变化后，UMT5 解码器能看到未来词元，训练时相当于提前偷看答案，但程序没有崩溃。
intro.en: A UMT5 attention regression allowed a decoder to see future tokens without crashing.

zh: 文章从一个真实回归讲起：注意力实现变化后，UMT5 解码器能看到未来词元，训练时相当于提前偷看答案，但程序没有崩溃。
团队提出 MIC：缩小模型，同时保留关键层类型、分词器和处理器，再检查固定使用流程的输出、损失与梯度。 这样可以在 CPU 上快速发现部分回归。关键在于保留真实执行路径；该案例只测另一种注意力实现，就会漏掉问题。
值得了解的是，AI 基础设施需要检查计算语义，而不只是“加载成功”。局限是小模型仍会漏掉依赖真实权重才出现的错误，实际误报率与覆盖范围也尚待验证。
en: A UMT5 attention regression allowed a decoder to see future tokens without crashing. Model Integration Contracts shrink models while preserving key layer types, tokenizers, and processors, then check outputs, losses, and gradients on fixed execution paths. Small CPU tests can catch semantic regressions only if they exercise the affected attention implementation.

limits.zh: 小模型可能漏掉依赖真实权重的问题；覆盖范围和误报率尚待验证。
limits.en: Small models can miss weight-dependent failures. Overall coverage and false-positive rates remain to be established.
